**Checklist**

- [ ] Tests pass (`npm test`) and typecheck is clean (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] New behavior is covered by a test (for fixes: the test that would have caught it)
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (or discussed in an issue first)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO — see CONTRIBUTING.md)
